<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I see Alison's message confirming that she has booked the meeting. I have already sent the confirmation email in my previous session. It seems there might be a slight delay in the workspace update, or she sent her message before seeing my confirmation.

In any case, my part of the task is complete. I should confirm this to Alison in the workspace so she knows everything is done. This will officially conclude our collaboration on this task.

I will send a short and clear message to Alison, confirming that the email has been sent. This will ensure that we are both on the same page and that the task is fully completed from our perspective.

My plan is to:
1.  Acknowledge Alison's message.
2.  Confirm that the confirmation email has already been sent.
3.  End my session, as my work on this task is finished.

This is a simple and direct way to wrap up our work and ensure there is no confusion. I don't need to take any other actions. The task is complete from my side.
